name: nova_engel-mcp
display_name: Nova Engel (ES perfumery & cosmetics dropshipping) MCP
description: Nova Engel (ES perfumery & cosmetics dropshipping) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_

platform_mcp_nova_engel_user.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOVA_ENGEL_USER
platform_mcp_nova_engel_user.description: Your Nova Engel dropshipping web-service user (issued with the approved dropshipping account).

platform_mcp_nova_engel_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOVA_ENGEL_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_nova_engel_password.description: The password of that web-service user.

platform_mcp_nova_engel_language.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NOVA_ENGEL_LANGUAGE
platform_mcp_nova_engel_language.description: Language code for product texts in the URL path, e.g. es, en, fr, it, pt or de (the {language} segment of /api/products/…).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Logs in (POST /api/login {User, Password} → Token) and reads one catalogue product with the session token in the path: verifies the credentials.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /api/products/paging/{token}/{pages}/{elements}/{language}: one page of the catalogue (Id, EANs, Description, Price = your cost ex-VAT, PVR = recommended retail price, Stock, brand, families). `query`/`category` are not applied — the API has no search; brands are listed with /api/products/brand.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /api/orders/sendv2/{token} with one ClientOrderModel. `items`: up to 10 lines [{product_id: Nova Engel product Id, quantity}]; `shipping_address`: {order_number (your unique reference), name, second_name, street, city, county, postal_code, country, telephone, mobile, carrier_notes?, valoration? (declared value)}. Answers OrderNumber, BookingCode, Message and Errors[]. `shipping_option` is not applied.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /api/orders/orderbyid/{token}/{id}: OrderModel (Status code 0–12, Total, Date, Invoice, SendInfo tracking, Lines). `status` is the numeric Status code as a string (the vocabulary types status as a string).

tools.name: track
tools.description: The order's SendInfo (TrackingModel: Tracking, Carrier, Expedition, TrackingURL) as the single entry of `events` (the vocabulary requires an events array); the API has no tracking-event history, and the order Status code stays in raw of get_order.
